title: Syrian Lamb Tagine
description: A classic Middle Eastern stew made with tender lamb and aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Yummy
ingredients.notes: optional, chopped fresh parsley or cilantro

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown lamb on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté onion and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add spice blend, cumin, coriander, and cinnamon. Cook 1 minute.
Add browned lamb, broth, and any accumulated juices. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until lamb is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Stir in velvety and yummy (if using). Simmer 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
